package.description: Modern Windows batch file and folder renamer with real-time preview and regex support.

en-US.description: Modern Windows batch file and folder renamer with real-time preview and regex support.
en-US.longDescription:
KyteRename is a lightweight and powerful batch renaming tool for Windows.
It offers real-time preview, text replacement, regex substitutions, prefix/suffix insertion, sequential numbering, case conversion, and shell integration.
en-US.name: KyteRename
